purpose: Generalization set - plan.md Section 8 test E. Every phenomenon type here is ABSENT from the five few-shot examples in scripts/baseline_prompt.py, which cover only moon-star conjunction, moon-planet conjunction, planet-planet conjunction, heliacal rising and lunar first visibility.
why_this_exists: qwen2.5:7b scored 3/5 on the main set, then 5/5 after two few-shot examples were added covering exactly the two failing phenomenon types. That demonstrates the model can reproduce a demonstrated pattern. It does NOT demonstrate that the model generalizes to a phenomenon it has never been shown, and the difference decides whether fine-tuning is needed. A high score here means prompting genuinely generalizes; a low score means the approach is coverage-dependent, which is a concrete argument for QLoRA (or at minimum for a much larger few-shot library).
sources: All drawn from the zero-gap usable units. Retrograde stations, last appearances, eclipses and acronychal risings are all real, recurring diary content - this is not an artificial stress test.
